draft_en.subject: Small industrial PoE switches for the fuel-center kits - under the AvaLAN label
draft_en.body:
Hi John,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 31 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the small industrial PoE switches you bundle with the fuel-center wireless kits, under the AvaLAN label from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x Gigabit + 1 x SFP, unmanaged, 44-57 V DC - model STI-154GP - $40.8 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-288GP - $62.2; the 8-port L2 managed on a Marvell platform - STI-288GPM - $85.5.

One question: which port count do the dispenser and canopy installs use most?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
